package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonExampleRepoPG stores first-class lesson examples in Postgres.
type LessonExampleRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) ReplaceByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, examples []domain.LessonExample) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(examples))
	for _, example := range examples {
		keys = append(keys, example.SourceKey)
	}
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example WHERE lesson_id=$1`, lessonID)
		return err
	}
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example WHERE lesson_id=$1 AND NOT (source_key = ANY($2::text[]))`, lessonID, keys); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, example := range examples {
		var persistedID string
		err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
INSERT INTO lesson_example (
    id, source_key, lesson_id, "order", status, mode, primary_stack, stacks, target_concepts
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)
ON CONFLICT (source_key) DO UPDATE SET
    "order"=EXCLUDED."order",
    status=EXCLUDED.status,
    mode=EXCLUDED.mode,
    primary_stack=EXCLUDED.primary_stack,
    stacks=EXCLUDED.stacks,
    target_concepts=EXCLUDED.target_concepts,
    updated_at=now()
WHERE lesson_example.lesson_id=EXCLUDED.lesson_id
RETURNING id`,
			example.ID,
			example.SourceKey,
			lessonID,
			example.Order,
			example.Status,
			example.Mode,
			example.PrimaryStack,
			example.Stacks,
			example.TargetConcepts,
		).Scan(&persistedID)
		if err != nil {
			if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
				return domain.ErrConflict
			}
			return mapPgError(err)
		}

		translationIDs := make([]int, 0, len(example.Translations))
		for _, translation := range example.Translations {
			translationIDs = append(translationIDs, translation.I18nID)
		}
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example_i18n WHERE example_id=$1 AND NOT (i18n_id = ANY($2::int[]))`, persistedID, translationIDs); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, translation := range example.Translations {
			_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO lesson_example_i18n (example_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (example_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET
    title=EXCLUDED.title,
    description=EXCLUDED.description`,
				persistedID,
				translation.I18nID,
				translation.Title,
				translation.Description,
			)
			if err != nil {
				return mapPgError(err)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, exampleID string) (*domain.LessonExample, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT
    e.id, e.source_key, e.lesson_id, COALESCE(l.source_key, ''), e."order", e.status,
    e.mode, e.primary_stack, e.stacks, e.target_concepts, e.created_at, e.updated_at
FROM lesson_example e
JOIN lesson l ON l.id=e.lesson_id
WHERE e.id=$1`, exampleID)
	var example domain.LessonExample
	if err := row.Scan(
		&example.ID,
		&example.SourceKey,
		&example.LessonID,
		&example.LessonSourceKey,
		&example.Order,
		&example.Status,
		&example.Mode,
		&example.PrimaryStack,
		&example.Stacks,
		&example.TargetConcepts,
		&example.CreatedAt,
		&example.UpdatedAt,
	); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	translations, err := r.listTranslationsByExample(ctx, exampleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	example.Translations = translations
	return &example, nil
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) ListByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	query := `
SELECT
    e.id, e.source_key, e.lesson_id, COALESCE(l.source_key, ''), e."order", e.status,
    e.mode, e.primary_stack, e.stacks, e.target_concepts, e.created_at, e.updated_at
FROM lesson_example e
JOIN lesson l ON l.id=e.lesson_id
WHERE e.lesson_id=$1`
	if activeOnly {
		query += ` AND e.status=1`
	}
	query += ` ORDER BY e."order", e.source_key`
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0)
	byID := make(map[string]int)
	for rows.Next() {
		var example domain.LessonExample
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&example.ID,
			&example.SourceKey,
			&example.LessonID,
			&example.LessonSourceKey,
			&example.Order,
			&example.Status,
			&example.Mode,
			&example.PrimaryStack,
			&example.Stacks,
			&example.TargetConcepts,
			&example.CreatedAt,
			&example.UpdatedAt,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		example.Translations = make([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, 0)
		byID[example.ID] = len(result)
		result = append(result, example)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	translations, err := r.listTranslationsByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if index, ok := byID[translation.ExampleID]; ok {
			result[index].Translations = append(result[index].Translations, translation)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, exampleID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	command, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example WHERE id=$1`, exampleID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) listTranslationsByExample(ctx context.Context, exampleID string) ([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, error) {
	return r.listTranslations(ctx, `WHERE ei.example_id=$1`, exampleID)
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) listTranslationsByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, error) {
	return r.listTranslations(ctx, `JOIN lesson_example e ON e.id=ei.example_id WHERE e.lesson_id=$1`, lessonID)
}

func (r LessonExampleRepoPG) listTranslations(ctx context.Context, scope string, value string) ([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT ei.example_id, ei.i18n_id, i.language, ei.title, ei.description
FROM lesson_example_i18n ei
JOIN i18n i ON i.id=ei.i18n_id
`+strings.TrimSpace(scope)+`
ORDER BY ei.example_id, i.language`, value)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var translation domain.LessonExampleI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&translation.ExampleID, &translation.I18nID, &translation.Language, &translation.Title, &translation.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, translation)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

var _ repository.LessonExampleRepository = (*LessonExampleRepoPG)(nil)
